content: Sawul ɓariki nǝ̀ wal-lú Dauda
Pǝlǝa Sawul banggi muna-ɓwabura male Jonatan andǝ amǝtúró male kat, ama ɓǝà wal-lú Dauda.
Sǝama Jonatan ngga kǝ̀ earce Dauda kǝ̀rkǝ́r.
Sǝ Jonatan ne Dauda ama, <<Tárrám Sawul kǝ alte nǝ̀ wal-luio. Acemani ka, ida tsǝkiro liwi nǝ dǝmbari. Alta ban sǝmbǝrǝa, do a banì.
Mǝ nǝ puro, sǝ mǝ nǝ cam a nkanggari tárrám a patal, a ban mǝnana a nda kam ngga. Mǝ nǝ banggi tárrám cau amuro. Sǝ cau mǝnana kat ǝn ok ka, mǝ nǝ banggo.>>

Nda Jonatan ne tárrí cau mǝɓoarne amúr Dauda ka. Banggi wi ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ murǝm ɓǝ̀kǝa pàkki guro male Dauda cauɓikea ɗàng, acemǝnana pàkkô cauɓikea ɗàng. A kún mani ka, agir mǝnana peǎ ka à yinanǝ mǝɓoarne a bano.

Twal yilǝmi a kún bui lang wal-lú ɓwa'Filisti, sǝ Yahweh pè Isǝrayila kat nggea limurǝm ngga. We nǝ nggearǝo ka a sǝni sǝ banɓoaro. Palang sǝ awu nǝ pàk cauɓikea arǝ nkila mala mǝ'kunpwasǝa, nǝ wal-lú Dauda mǝnana pàkkô kǝ mǝɓane raka?>>
Pǝlǝa Sawul kwakikiri arǝ cau mala Jonatan, sǝ kángir ama, <<Mbak-kàngkàng Yahweh nakam ngga, à pà nǝ̀ wal-lú Dauda ɗàng.>>
Nda Jonatan tunǝ Dauda sǝ ne wi acau mǝnia kat ka. Pǝlǝa Jonatan yinǝ Dauda aban Sawul, sǝ Dauda lidǝmba nǝ pàkkî Sawul túró kǝla mǝnana a dǝmbe ka.
Munǝo lo ɗǝm anre ka amǝ'Filisti andǝ amǝ'Isǝrayila. Sǝ Dauda puro oa munǝo arǝ amǝ'Filisti, sǝ walia nǝ nggea walban, gandǝa amǝ'Filisti ɓanggi wi.
Pǝlǝa ɓè bangŋo mǝɓike
pùr nǝban Yahweh sǝ sulǝ amúr Sawul. Sawul naban dumnǝdo a ɓala male nǝ nzo male a buì, sǝ Dauda ka ndaban wal jerang.
Pǝlǝa Sawul ɓariki ama nǝ̀ tǝm Dauda nǝ nzo, nǝ̀ laptǝi arǝ bumkurǝm, sǝama Dauda vwaki, sǝ putǝlì ɓadǝm Sawul, sǝ nzo wario kya tǝm bumkurǝm. Nǝ du mala pwari mǝno ka, Dauda ɓangŋa auwa.

Sawul tasǝ amǝ'na-túrbân a ɓala mala Dauda ace mǝnana ɓǝà tsǝkmǝsǝia arǝì, sǝ ɓǝà wal-lui nǝ dǝmbari. Pǝlǝa Mikal mālá Dauda, banggi wi ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ a ɓangŋa a amsǝ yilǝmo nǝ dù man raka, liwi ka, à nǝ̀ wal-luio!>>
Nda Mikal sulǝ Dauda a nzali nǝban mǝsǝkurǝm, pǝlǝa ɓangŋa o auwa.
Pǝlǝa Mikal twal ɓǝ̀nzál,
sǝ nongsǝi amúr kpamgbang-nongŋo. Sǝ tsǝki wi gìr-loasǝmúrû mala nyang mbul a ban ɓamuri, sǝ kumsǝi wi nggubyau.
Lang Sawul tasǝ amǝ'na-túrbân ɓǝà kya bwal Dauda ka, Mikal nea wia ama, <<Dauda pà jam ɗàng.>>
Pǝlǝa Sawul nyesǝ amǝ'na-túrbân ama ɓǝà kya sǝn Dauda nǝ nggearǝia. Banggia wia ama, <<Wu twali wu yinǝam nǝi amúr kpamgbang-nongŋo male, ace mǝnana mǝ wal-luí ka.>>
Lang amǝ'na-túrbân wari ka, à kum ɓǝ̀nzál na aban nongŋo amúr kpamgbang-nongŋo andǝ gìr-loasǝmúrû mala nyang mbul a ban ɓamuri.
Sawul banggi Mikal ama, <<Palang sǝ a swarkiam anggo, sǝ a nying ɓiam-mǝbura ɓangŋa o?>> Mikal eari wi ama, <<Dauda banggam ama ɓǝ̀n bwali wi purî ɓala raka, nǝ̀ wal-luem.>>
Lang Dauda ɓangŋǝna sǝ auna ka, wari aban Samuyila a Rama, sǝ ne wi gìr mǝnana kat Sawul pàkki wi ka. Pǝlǝa yì andǝ Samuyila o, sǝ à kya do a Nayot.
Cau yiu aban Sawul ama, <<Sǝni, Dauda na a Nayot a Rama.>>

Nda Sawul tasǝ amǝ'na-túrbân ɓǝ̀ à kya bwal Dauda. Sǝama lang à wari ka, à kya kum nggǝsan mala amǝɓangnǝa aban nakiacau ɓangnǝa, sǝ Samuyila nakam aban came abanì kǝla ɓwamǝgule amúrià. Bangŋo mala Ɓakuli sulǝ amúr amǝ'na-túrbân mala Sawul mǝno, sǝ à nacau ɓangnǝa gbal.

Lang à banggi Sawul gìr mǝnana kum amǝ'na-túrbân male ka, nyare Sawul tasǝ aɓea amǝ'na-túrbân, sǝ yià gbal ka à nacau ɓangnǝa. Sawul tasǝ tàruia amǝ'na-túrbân ɗǝm, sǝ yià gbal ka à kya kútí a nacau ɓangnǝa.
A masǝlǝate ka, Sawul lo nǝ nggearǝì wari a Rama. Lang yi bingŋǝna ban tūli-mùr mǝgule mǝnana a Seku ka, ɗìban ama, <<Samuyila andǝ Dauda na ke?>> À eari wi ama, <<À nda a Nayot, a Rama.>>
Pǝlǝa Sawul wari a Nayot a Rama. Bangŋo mala Ɓakuli sulǝ amurí gbal; kǝ nacau ɓangnǝa sǝ kǝ gya aban ká she lang yina a Nayot a Rama ka.
Yale swárki agir-nggūrǝì, sǝ nacau ɓangnǝa aɓadǝm Samuyila. Sawul nong gbǝrangtang aɓa pwari mǝno kat andǝ dù mǝno kat. Acemani ka, aɓwana ɗiban ama, <<Sawul gbal ka, nda aɓalǝ amǝɓangnǝa le?>>

footnotes.text: Ɓalli gbal aɓa kúrè 18 mǝsǝi 1 mala malǝmce man.
bangŋo mǝɓike Sǝni gbal aɓa kúrè 16 mǝsǝi 14 mala malǝmce man.
